scripts.cf-bundle: npm exec -- wrangler build --config wrangler.build.toml && sed -e 's/from "async_hooks"/from "node:async_hooks"/g' -e 's/from "assert"/from "node:assert"/g' -e 's/from "buffer"/from "node:buffer"/g' -e 's/from "crypto"/from "node:crypto"/g' -e 's/from "path"/from "node:path"/g' -e 's/from "stream"/from "node:stream"/g' -e 's/from "url"/from "node:url"/g' -e 's/from "util"/from "node:util"/g' -e 's/from "zlib"/from "node:zlib"/g' dist/worker.js > .open-next/_worker.js && sed -i '' 's/__ASSETS_RUN_WORKER_FIRST__: false/__ASSETS_RUN_WORKER_FIRST__: true/g' .open-next/_worker.js && cp -r .open-next/assets/* .open-next/
